Title: Azure Monitor Log Analytics Quick Start content is moving to the Overview page

Body.Content:
In order to simplify and streamline Log Analytics, we're moving all links and content from the Quick Start page to the Overview page. The Quick Start page will be removed in August 2020.

All links and functionality of the Quick Start page are available in the upgraded Overview page:

To reach the new Overview page go to your Log Analytics workspace and select Overview from the menu.
